non_blocking_gaps.description: Env-var naming drift between scaffold-generated .env.example files and the LLD config.py field expectations. LLD declares pydantic Settings reads `api_cors_origins` and `api_env`; backend/.env.example exposes them as `APP_CORS_ORIGINS` and `APP_ENV`. LLD also expects `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` for the frontend client (per LLD file `frontend/src/lib/api/client.ts` line 'baseURL: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL'); frontend/.env.example exposes `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`. Pydantic-settings will silently fall back to defaults — code can be written but runtime cors/url config will be wrong unless aligned.
non_blocking_gaps.resolution: During /ases-sprint-scaffold S1, rename .env.example variables to match LLD field names: APP_CORS_ORIGINS → API_CORS_ORIGINS, APP_ENV → API_ENV, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL → NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL. Update root .env.example, backend/.env.example, and frontend/.env.example consistently. Affects 3 files; mechanical edit. Alternative: change LLD Settings field names to match scaffold convention — NOT recommended since LLD is the design source-of-truth at this stage.

non_blocking_gaps.description: Frontend test framework (jest + @testing-library/react + @testing-library/jest-dom + @testing-library/user-event) is not in deps_manifest.json and not in scaffold.installed_packages_summary, yet 8 jest test cases exist in test_cases.json (TC-039 through TC-046). Tests are not runnable until installed. Note: this gap does not block /ases-dev — only blocks /ases-test-impl S1.
non_blocking_gaps.resolution: Extend deps_manifest.json packages[] with jest@30.x + @testing-library/react@16.x + @testing-library/jest-dom@6.x + @testing-library/user-event@14.x as type='dev', required_by='frontend/src/**/__tests__/**'. Install via `npm install -D` during /ases-sprint-scaffold S1's frontend pass. Echo of sprint_gate.md W1.

non_blocking_gaps.description: Integration tests TC-018, TC-026, TC-033..TC-038 (8 cases) require a separate PostgreSQL test database. deps_manifest declares only the development DB service. testcontainers-postgres / pytest-postgresql / fresh-schema / sqlite-in-memory strategy is unsettled.
non_blocking_gaps.resolution: Add one dedicated task in /ases-tasks S1 'Configure integration test database' that decides + implements the strategy. ASES default is testcontainers-postgres (matches HLD R-001 mitigation of using real PG semantics including SELECT FOR UPDATE for S2). If testcontainers chosen: add `testcontainers[postgres]==4.9.0` + Docker daemon dependency to deps_manifest. Echo of sprint_gate.md W2.

non_blocking_gaps.description: Database bootstrap is NOT YET VERIFIED per scaffold.json (`bootstrap_verified: false`). Docker not installed on host at scaffold time. bootstrap.sql is mounted to docker-init.d but has never executed against a live container.
non_blocking_gaps.resolution: PO action — required BEFORE /ases-test-run S1 (not before /ases-dev). Steps: (1) install Docker Desktop on Windows host; (2) `docker-compose up -d db`; (3) `docker logs jayanth_db` shows `01_bootstrap.sql ... completed cleanly`; (4) verify `psql -U trading_app -d jayanth_trading -h localhost -c '\dt'` returns empty list. Documented in scaffold.json.post_scaffold_actions_required_by_po.

non_blocking_gaps.description: `backend/db/migrations/env.py` exists in LLD files[] but does NOT exist on disk. The scaffold created `alembic.ini` and `backend/db/migrations/versions/0001_baseline.sql` (placeholder), but the alembic env wiring (sqlalchemy.url from settings, target_metadata = Base.metadata) was not generated. non_blocking_gaps.resolution: /ases-sprint-scaffold S1 must run `alembic init` (or write env.py directly) and wire target_metadata + url. This is the first item /ases-sprint-scaffold S1 should produce so /ases-dev can then run `alembic revision --autogenerate -m 'master tables'` to materialise 0002_master_tables.py from the ORM (DS-009). Listed in scaffold-pending below; not a code gap (this is the expected handoff).
